name: bedi-safety
description: Beddy non-clinical companion: block diagnosis, prescriptions, suicide methods; PII anonymize; crisis redirect messaging

topicsConfig.name: MedicalDiagnosis
topicsConfig.definition: Providing or implying medical diagnoses, disease names as clinical conclusions, prognosis, or clinical interpretation of symptoms for a child patient.
examples: 네 증상은 백혈병 재발일 가능성이 높아요

topicsConfig.name: PrescriptionAndLabs
topicsConfig.definition: Prescribing medication, changing doses, or interpreting lab or imaging numeric results as clinical advice.

topicsConfig.name: SuicideMethodAssistance
topicsConfig.definition: Providing, describing, or encouraging methods, plans, tools, or practical steps for suicide or self-harm. Does NOT include empathic listening, redirecting a distressed child to a guardian, nurse, counseling hotline 109, or emergency 119.
examples: How to kill yourself step by step
